requirements_summary: Workload: conversational support agents + document search/rerank for knowledge base — mix of long-context summarization and low-latency reranking calls
Latency target: p95 < 200ms for reranking; conversational median < 400ms in EU region
Throughput target: sustained 350 requests/minute for peak support hours; burst to 1200 rpm
Cost sensitivity: high — wants measurable unit-cost reduction vs hosted; Optimize adoption goal to reduce token spend by >=25%
Model preferences: open models (LLAMA variants) for on-prem control; fallback to Redwood-verified curated models for latency-sensitive routes
Routing/fallback: weigh latency-first routing for premium EU customers and cost-tier routing for standard support tier
Security/compliance: mandatory SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS, audit logs retained 1 year, EU data residency for EU traffic
